scripts.build:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=1 ELECTRON=false vite build --mode production
scripts.build:electron: cross-env VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=1 ELECTRON=true VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop vite build --mode desktop
scripts.build:desktop: cross-env VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=1 ELECTRON=true VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop vite build --mode desktop
scripts.desktop:build: cross-env VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=1 ELECTRON=true VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop vite build --mode desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis
scripts.desktop:dev: cross-env VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=1 ELECTRON=true VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop electron electron/main.js
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.electron:build-backend: cd ../backend-zapeera-v1-main && npm run setup:electron && npm run build
scripts.electron:dist:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac
scripts.electron:dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux
scripts.electron:dist:all: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win --mac --linux
scripts.electron:dist:win:exe: npm run build:electron && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis
scripts.electron:dist:mac:dmg: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg
scripts.electron:dist:linux:deb: npm run build && npm run electron:build-backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux deb
scripts.mobile:dev:android: npm run build && npx cap run android
scripts.mobile:dev:ios: npm run build && npx cap run ios
scripts.mobile:build:android: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.mobile:build:ios: npm run build && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release
